name: s11-resp-mcp-server
config:
[[permissions]]
tool = "apply_patch"
pattern = "*"
decision = "allow"
[[permissions]]
tool = "run_command"
pattern = "python -m pytest*"
decision = "allow"

Find the cause, fix it, and verify the fix.", "config": {"runtime.max_tool_rounds": 40}}}, {"name": "foundry-reply", "arguments": {"sessionId": "$last", "prompt": "Add a test that adds two negative numbers, and run the suite again."}}]
